questions.question: The national bird of India is the:
questions.explanation: The Indian peacock is the national bird.

questions.question: Which vitamin is produced when skin is exposed to sunlight?
questions.explanation: Sunlight triggers Vitamin D synthesis in the skin.

questions.question: The Khajuraho temples were built by which dynasty?
questions.explanation: The Chandela dynasty built the Khajuraho temples.

questions.question: Which element is essential for the formation of haemoglobin?
questions.explanation: Iron is essential for haemoglobin formation.

questions.question: The Rajya Sabha has a maximum strength of:
questions.explanation: The maximum strength of the Rajya Sabha is 250 members.

questions.question: Which Indian city is known as the "Pink City"?
questions.explanation: Jaipur is known as the Pink City.

questions.question: Sound cannot travel through:
questions.explanation: Sound needs a medium and cannot travel through a vacuum.

questions.question: The capital of British India was shifted from Calcutta to Delhi in:
questions.explanation: The capital was shifted to Delhi in 1911.

questions.question: Which is the densest planet in the solar system?
questions.explanation: Earth is the densest planet in the solar system.

questions.question: The Olympic Games are held once every how many years?
questions.explanation: The Summer Olympics are held every 4 years.

questions.question: Who gave the slogan "Do or Die"?
questions.explanation: Gandhi gave "Do or Die" during the Quit India Movement.

questions.question: The national flower of India is the:
questions.explanation: The lotus is India’s national flower.

questions.question: Which is the longest river flowing within India?
questions.explanation: The Ganga (~2,525 km) is the longest river within India.

questions.question: The instrument used to measure atmospheric pressure is the:
questions.explanation: A barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.question: In which year was the Reserve Bank of India established?
questions.explanation: The RBI was established in 1935.

questions.question: Which day is celebrated as International Yoga Day?
questions.explanation: International Yoga Day is 21 June.

questions.question: The term of a member of the Lok Sabha is normally:
questions.explanation: A Lok Sabha term is normally 5 years.

questions.question: Which planet is known as the "Red Planet"?
questions.explanation: Mars looks red due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.question: Who administers the oath of office to the President of India?
questions.explanation: The Chief Justice of India administers the oath to the President.

questions.question: The ancient university of Nalanda was located in present-day:
questions.explanation: Nalanda is in present-day Bihar.

questions.question: Who was the last Governor-General of independent India?
questions.explanation: C. Rajagopalachari was the last and only Indian Governor-General.

questions.question: Which is the smallest continent by area?
questions.explanation: Australia is the smallest continent.

questions.question: The Non-Cooperation Movement was launched by Gandhi in:
questions.explanation: The Non-Cooperation Movement began in 1920.

questions.question: Who is the supreme commander of the Indian Armed Forces?
questions.explanation: The President is the supreme commander of the armed forces.

questions.question: "Vidhan Sabha" refers to the:
questions.explanation: Vidhan Sabha is the State Legislative Assembly.

questions.question: Which part of the plant conducts photosynthesis using the green pigment?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll is the green pigment that captures light energy.

questions.question: Who was the first woman Prime Minister of India?
questions.explanation: Indira Gandhi became PM in 1966.

questions.question: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.explanation: The Pacific is the largest and deepest ocean.

questions.question: Emperor Ashoka belonged to which dynasty?
questions.explanation: Ashoka was a Mauryan emperor.

questions.question: The Indian National Congress was founded in which year?
questions.explanation: The INC was founded in 1885 by A.O. Hume.

questions.question: The gas responsible for the greenhouse effect is mainly:
questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide is the main greenhouse gas.

questions.question: The national animal of India is the:
questions.explanation: The Royal Bengal Tiger is India’s national animal.

questions.question: The currency of the United States is the:
questions.explanation: The US currency is the Dollar.

questions.question: The chemical symbol for gold is:
questions.explanation: Gold’s symbol Au comes from Latin "aurum".

questions.question: The Param Vir Chakra is awarded for:
questions.explanation: The Param Vir Chakra is India’s highest wartime gallantry award.

questions.question: Photosynthesis mainly takes place in the:
questions.explanation: Leaves contain chlorophyll where photosynthesis occurs.

questions.question: Which is the southernmost point of mainland India?
questions.explanation: Kanyakumari is the southernmost point of mainland India (Indira Point is the southernmost of Indian territory).

questions.question: Who composed the song "Vande Mataram"?
questions.explanation: Bankim Chandra Chatterjee wrote "Vande Mataram".

questions.question: A money bill can be introduced only in the:
questions.explanation: A money bill can be introduced only in the Lok Sabha.

questions.question: Which is the lightest gas?
questions.explanation: Hydrogen is the lightest gas.

questions.question: If today is Thursday, what day will it be after 88 days?
questions.explanation: 88 mod 7 = 4; Thursday + 4 = Monday.

questions.question: Which letter is 2nd to the right of the 5th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 5th letter = E; 5 + 2 = 7th letter = G.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (5, 125), (9, 729), (6, 215), (8, 512)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 6³ = 216, not 215.

questions.question: In a row of 52 students, Ravi is 38th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 52 − 38 + 1 = 15.

questions.question: Find the next term: 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 4²…8². Next is 9² = 81.

questions.question: Find the next term: 3, 8, 16, 27, 41, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 3 each step; next difference is 17, so 41 + 17 = 58.

questions.question: If TREE is coded as WUHH, how is CAT coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 3. Applying the same to CAT gives FDW.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 4:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 4:00 the angle is 4 × 30° = 120°.
The relation is squaring: 10² = 100, so 9² = 81.

questions.question: A person walks 8 km East and then 15 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(8² + 15²) = √289 = 17 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 9 + 4 × 2.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 9 × 4 − 2 = 36 − 2 = 34.

questions.question: Find the next term: 5, 11, 23, 47, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×2 + 1: 47 × 2 + 1 = 95.

questions.question: Complete the series: E, G, I, K, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 2 places, so the next is M.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 19, 17, 11, 25
questions.explanation: 17, 19, 11 are prime numbers; 25 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 7th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 7th letter from the right is the 20th from the left = T.
The relation is cubing: 6³ = 216, so 6³ = 216.

questions.question: If today is Tuesday, what day will it be after 18 days?
questions.explanation: 18 mod 7 = 4; Tuesday + 4 = Saturday.

questions.question: Which letter is 6th to the right of the 8th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 8th letter = H; 8 + 6 = 14th letter = N.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (3, 28), (4, 64), (2, 8), (5, 125)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 3³ = 27, not 28.

questions.question: In a row of 55 students, Ravi is 25th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 55 − 25 + 1 = 31.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 6, 11, 19, 30, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 3 each step; next difference is 14, so 30 + 14 = 44.

questions.question: Find the next term: 1, 6, 14, 25, 39, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 3 each step; next difference is 17, so 39 + 17 = 56.

questions.question: If STAR is coded as UVCT, how is PEN coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 2. Applying the same to PEN gives RGP.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 3:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 3:00 the angle is 3 × 30° = 90°.
The relation is squaring: 11² = 121, so 11² = 121.

questions.question: What is 20% of 260?
Find the simple interest on ₹2100 at 4% per annum for 2 years.
Find the compound interest on ₹2000 at 5% per annum for 2 years.
An article costing ₹900 is sold for ₹1125. Find the profit percentage.
An article costing ₹540 is sold at a 5% profit. Find the selling price.
Find the average of the first five multiples of 7.
Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 7 and their sum is 48. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 12. Each part = 48/12 = 4. Larger = 7 × 4 = 28.

questions.question: A train 160 m long crosses a pole in 8 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 20 days and B in 30 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/20 + 1/30 = 50/600. Time = 600/50 = 12 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 28 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
Find the value of √1089.
After a 20% discount, an item costs ₹560. Find its marked price.
Find 10% of 20% of 1700.
Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 7 and their difference is 14. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 2 parts = 14, so each part = 7. Smaller = 5 × 7 = 35.

questions.question: A boat travels 39 km downstream in 3 hours. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 39/3 = 13 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 13 − 2 = 11 km/h.
